desc: Derive the exact permutation-counting formula for a fixed element and suffix subset of size \(k\).
Group numbers \(1,\ldots,N\) by decimal digit length, computing each class weight, count, and sum of values.
Compute the global elementary-symmetric coefficients and per-class omitted-factor coefficients in \(O(DN)\), where \(D\le 6\).
Precompute factorials and combine all class contributions modulo \(998244353\).
Implement input parsing, modular arithmetic, and output the final answer.
